children: Hecla recast its 2025 Form 10-K and Q1 2026 Form 10-Q after selling Casa Berardi and changing income statement presentation.
Sold Casa Berardi (Hecla Quebec) to Orezone for total fair value of $385.7M (undiscounted up to $602.2M).
Consideration included $170.0M cash, $16.6M working capital receivable, 65.76M Orezone shares ($106.1M) and $57.1M deferred cash.
Up to $241M contingent payments (fair value $35.9M) tied to gold-price triggers, permits and future gold production royalties.
Casa Berardi is now a discontinued operation; 2025 and Q1 2026 filings were recast to exclude it from continuing operations and segments.
Income statement presentation recast: removed "Total Cost of Sales" and "Gross Profit" lines and renamed "ramp-up and suspension costs" to "care and maintenance".
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
